scope: Prevent supplier credit accounting from consuming a claim that its original return never posted.
behavior: After exact invoice/return mappings and before any credit journal, supplier balance, ledger entry or credit record, verify the effective original return journal, original receipt recognition, canonical currency and each mapped source-owned invoiced claim quantity/value. Recovered return journals resolve through immutable resolution events. Pending returns require explicit authorized recovery first. Unmarked legacy claim funding requires accounting source review.
dbReverification: Parent agent owns actual PostgreSQL chain and final receipt.
